beats.label: SAY
beats.note: Can you teach this to me?

copy.caption: Instead of quizzing them, try: “Can you teach this to me?” Teaching it back shows what they know and what's still fuzzy, and you don't have to ask 20 questions. Free Parent Script Cards: link in bio.
copy.yt_title: Help Your Child Study: Say “Teach This to Me” (Parent Script)
copy.pin_title: How to Help Kids Study: Ask Them to Teach It Back
copy.pin_desc: A parent script for study time: ask “Can you teach this to me?” Explaining it back shows what your child knows and what is still fuzzy. For parents of kids 9-13, from the Julia Redmond executive function series.
